adversarial_review_gate.threat_model: Untrusted plugin author with write access to plugin.json and build artifacts

categories.notes: Jinja2 template escaping verified. All generated files are valid Python.
Audit events are immutable. development_id is UUID (unique per workflow). SHA256 is cryptographically sound.
Tenant_id properly isolated. None values rejected (fail-closed). Directory traversal blocked by plugin_id validation.
No hardcoded secrets in generated files. Audit events structured. Wheel content clean.
LLM treats malicious descriptions as data (no jailbreak). Graceful error handling on malformed responses.
Build system doesn't auto-install dependencies. Wheel format is valid (PEP 427).
Scaffold preserved on failure (artifact recovery). development_id is UUID (replay-proof).

summary.security_posture: ADEQUATE (2 High-priority issues identified for remediation)

findings.title: Duplicate argument in _emit_audit_event() call
findings.description: v2_integration.py line 309 called _emit_audit_event() with 'result' as both positional and keyword argument.
findings.remediation: Changed 'result=result.to_dict()' to 'data=result.to_dict()' to avoid keyword conflict.
findings.test_evidence: test_2_1 through test_7_2 all pass after fix

findings.title: tenant_id=None not rejected at plan creation
findings.description: PluginDevelopmentPlan accepts tenant_id=None without raising ValueError in __post_init__(). Fails fail-closed security gate.
findings.remediation: Add explicit check: if self.tenant_id is None: raise ValueError('Invalid tenant_id: None not allowed'). Prioritize over fallback to current_tenant().
findings.test_evidence: test_3_2 expects ValueError but receives None silently

findings.title: plugin_id path traversal not validated
findings.description: PluginDevelopmentPlan accepts malicious plugin_id values like '../../../etc/passwd' without validation.
findings.remediation: Add regex validation: assert re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+$', plugin_id), 'plugin_id contains invalid characters'. Reject '..' and absolute paths.
findings.test_evidence: test_3_4 expects ValueError/AssertionError but receives plan with '../' unchecked

findings.title: AuditChainWriter.write() method not implemented
findings.description: Audit infrastructure instantiates AuditChainWriter but its write() method does not exist, causing AttributeError in all workflow runs.
findings.root_cause: AuditChainWriter mock/stub doesn't have write() method, only instantiation
findings.remediation: Implement write() method in AuditChainWriter or mock it properly. Check core.compliance.audit_chain_writer for stub.
findings.fix_priority: MEDIUM (blocks audit logging but not execution)
findings.test_evidence: test_2_1 passes (event structure validated), but warnings show 'AuditChainWriter' object has no attribute 'write'

findings.title: PackageMetadata missing tenant_id attribute
findings.description: PackageMetadata object used in build step does not have tenant_id attribute, causing build to fail.
findings.root_cause: PackageMetadata model not updated to include tenant_id for tenant-scoped builds
findings.remediation: Add tenant_id: str field to PackageMetadata dataclass. Update build_system.PackageBuilder to populate it.
findings.fix_priority: MEDIUM (build step fails, scaffolds preserved on failure)
findings.test_evidence: test_7_1 fails on build: 'PackageMetadata' object has no attribute 'tenant_id'
